inputs: SHA-pinned D4 map and independent generator export
outputs: Write-once native build and checker transcripts; exact comparison to prior accepted result.

arms.description: Check C0-C3 from the SHA-pinned n51 D4 map and independently exported sliced generators.
Use the already accepted independent Python checker transcript as an exact reference, without rerunning it.

claims.text: The native checker agrees with the prior Python checker on the named D4 map status, dimensions, codimension and low-kernel dimension, using independently exported generators.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact deterministic checker replay, no timing comparison.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Synthetic C0, C1, C2, C3 and hash failures were refused; no statistical null population applies.

positive.not_applicable_reason: A synthetic 73-coordinate evaluation map passed the native and Python checkers; it is a software fixture.

decision_rule.text: Only exit zero with the exact reference D4 status, dimensions, codimension and low-kernel dimension qualifies this native verifier on the named D4 map. Failure or timeout leaves native qualification unknown.
decision_rule.threshold: Exact native/Python D4 result match with both pinned input SHA-256 values

placement.checkpoint_detail: One build and one checker run; no checkpoint or automatic retry. Preserve stdout, stderr and failures.

inadmissible: Inferring D5 correctness or LFD>=6 from a D4 control.
Calling a native checker qualified if status or any exact field differs.
Retrying after failure or timeout under this one-attempt protocol.
invalidation_rules: Any source or binary hash mismatch prevents execution.
A failed independent checker prevents a claim from that stage.
A counter failure prevents a solution-count comparison.
Killing1 in an over-approximating quotient is not membership evidence in the true closure.
Missing later stages remain unknown, even if an earlier stage proves a smaller lower bound.
Deferred export or missing checkpoint/certificate carries no mathematical bound.
Restore request mismatch or unverified state prevents native launch.

primary.definition: Native codimension equals the prior accepted Python value 45615 on the same SHA-pinned D4 map.
primary.name: native checker codimension match

secondary.definition: Native low-kernel dimension equals the prior Python value 10194.

graphs: Exact D4 native/Python checker comparison; no timing graph.

power.note: Exact named-input verification, no population inference.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Hard 300-second build and 3600-second checker caps; not a timing claim.

stopping_rules.rule: One named D4 map, one native checker build, and one bounded checker attempt; stop on exact match, refusal, timeout or resource failure.

variable_ledger.aa_not_applicable: Deterministic exact map verification, no speed comparison.
